title: Needs of Living Things
seo_title: Grade 1 Science: Needs of Living Things Worksheets (Ontario Curriculum)
standard_text: Describe the needs of plants and animals, including humans; describe how living things depend on their environment and how people can care for living things. (summary of the Ontario Science and Technology curriculum, 2022, Strand B: Life Systems – Needs and Characteristics of Living Things)
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 science worksheets on what plants, animals and people need to live, with pictures. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Living things need food, water and air.
key_sub: Animals need shelter too. Plants need sunlight and soil.
body_html:
How to think about it

All living things need food, water and air.

  • Animals need shelter and space.
  • Plants need sunlight, water and soil.
  • People help pets and plants get what they need.
Example

What does a plant need?

light

water

Answer: sunlight and water

Example

Where does a squirrel live?

in a tree

Answer: in a nest

Common mistakes

  • Thinking plants eat food like animals do.
  • Thinking pets can look after themselves.
